text:
Alice M: Heads-up, deploybot just quarantined RC-0.9.1 in canary. SBOM missing cosign signature + vuln scan reported a medium transitive CVE in libfoo.
Ben T: link to deploybot alert: https://deploybot.internal/alerts/1732109999 :eyes:
Carlos S: Can you paste the exact vuln id and SBOM error from the bot output?
deploy-bot: BOT: Release RC-0.9.1 canary blocked. Reasons:\n - SBOM: cosign signature not found for artifact digest sha256:abcd...\n - Vuln scan: CVE-2024-9999 (transitive, libfoo v1.2.3) severity=MEDIUM, path=ourpkg -> depA -> libfoo\n - Block policy: prod-canary requires signed SBOM + no new CVEs >= MEDIUM except allowed list
Dana R: We pushed a rebuild earlier; cosign step might have failed on the CI runner. I can re-run signing for the canary image.
Alice M: What's the impact if we timebox a roll-forward while we re-sign? We're mid-change window with traffic routing 10% canary.
Carlos S: Security preference is to block. But given transitive medium CVE with no exploit telemetry, we could do a staggered carveout only after legal + sec ok. Need exception recorded.
Ben T: @Emma L can you do a quick legal signoff on temporary carveout if sec approves? We need explicit approval in ticket.
Emma L: I can approve a timeboxed carveout (max 48h) only if Sec provides mitigation plan and we update release notes. Also need an audit entry: https://jira.internal/PROJECT-12345
Carlos S: Mitigation: add runtime rule to block the vulnerable api surface in libfoo via feature-flag; add monitoring alert for increased errors. Also pin transitive dep to patched version in a follow-up hotpatch.
Dana R: I'll re-run CI sign+push now, but if signing fails, can we do a controlled canary with 1% traffic and immediate rollback criteria? deploybot, what's the minimum traffic allowed by policy?
deploy-bot: BOT: Minimum allowed canary traffic for change-window rollout is 1%. Fallback: immediate rollback on error rate >0.5% or latency P95 regressed >100ms.
Alice M: OK. Plan: 1) try re-sign & push (Dana). 2) If sign fails or takes >30m, ask @Emma L for timeboxed carveout with Sec mitigation (Carlos). 3) If carveout granted, launch at 1% with strict rollback rules. 4) Hotpatch pin in next patch release.
Ben T: I'll open the JIRA, add the bot output + proposed mitigation, and tag Emma/Carlos. Ticket: PROJECT-12345.
Emma L: Add wording: "timeboxed carveout granted pending mitigation and audit; revert if alerts fire". I'll review once Ben updates.
Dana R: CI re-sign started: `./ci/release/sign-and-push.sh rc-0.9.1` output: Signing succeeded. Pushed digest sha256:abcd...cosigned
deploy-bot: BOT: New artifact signed. Re-running SBOM verify...\nSBOM verify: OK\nVuln scan: CVE-2024-9999 still present (transitive) severity=MEDIUM\nBlock policy still blocks deployment due to explicit deny on new MEDIUM CVEs unless exception.
Carlos S: Given signing passed, we still need the exception route. I'll run a short analysis to confirm no exploitable paths. If low risk, I can approve temporary exception and set monitoring playbook.
Alice M: If Carlos gives verbal sec ack within 20m we can proceed with a 1% carveout and follow the rollback thresholds. Everyone OK with that?
Ben T: fine from eng side. I'll wait for sec + legal ticket update.
Carlos S: Sec ack: low exploitability, mitigation steps accepted. Granting temporary exception with conditions documented in PROJECT-12345. :white_check_mark:
Emma L: Legal acked the wording in the ticket and set 48h timebox. Make sure release notes include note: "staged rollout due to transitive CVE; hotpatch incoming".
Alice M: Launching 1% now. Monitor closely, call if anything abnormal. Thanks team.
Dana R: Canary live at 1% -> monitoring dashboards linked: https://metrics.internal/dashboards/rc-0.9.1
deploy-bot: BOT: Canary started at 1%. Will auto-rollback on error_rate>0.5% or latency_p95_increase>100ms. Audit: exception recorded PROJECT-12345.
Alice M: Closing thread; will update once we decide to expand or rollback. :thumbsup:
